about: Port-side blocker ledger (#5051), beside field_testing.json's engine/forge defect log (docs/language_status/port_blockers.md, generated by tests/tools/port_blockers.py). A port-side blocker is anything that kept a program from being translated whole or proven, other than an engine/forge FACT defect: the deterministic port, the transaction forge, the facade, the equivalence harness or the runtime. Log one in the same PR that finds or fixes it. `estate` is the burned estate that exposed it (an `estates` id of field_testing.json, restricted to estate4_draw.BURNED_NAMES) with `after_round` = that estate's round; a blocker with no single estate has `estate` null, `found_by` one of review / crucible / sibling sweep, and `after_round` = the last round checked before it. `class` is one of the vocabulary below; `new_class` is true on the first blocker of a class (the validator derives it and rejects a wrong value). `refused_by_name` is true when the fix is a named refusal, not a model. `programs` are the programs blocked, as named in the issue; `issue` and/or `fixed_by` (#PR) are required. Non-burned census and blind-estate repos never appear here (mainframe-evidence-policy.md).

blockers.summary: A Db2 case stopped proving in the nightly, and PR CI skipped Db2 cases (det sweep --skip-db2), so a PR that moved its port was never proven before merge.
A space-filled zoned item moved to a binary host variable: GnuCOBOL gave 931773840, the det port 0; IBM documents no result for non-digit data (oracle assumption C11).
EXEC CICS WEB family (OPEN, CONVERSE, CLOSE, PARSE, SEND, RECEIVE, EXTRACT, HTTPHEADER): zECS is served over HTTP, so the harness has to state the HTTP peer.
READ GTEQ / DELETE GENERIC on a file named at run time by a template (ZC##DC): no single file to bind a key length to.
The harness could not state ASSIGN STARTCODE, EIBFN or EIBRCODE (3 estates, 7 programs one gap from proven); found by a measurement across estates, not on one.
The forge's copybook fallback did not follow EXEC SQL INCLUDE or COPY ... IN <library>, so records declared there were not found.
Forge reachability treated an exhaustive EVALUATE whose every branch transfers control as falling through.
Generated code used String.format / toUpperCase / toLowerCase without Locale.ROOT, so output depended on the JVM locale.
The equivalence harness could not inject SQL faults, so SQLCODE error branches were never proven (register M2).
LINK COMMAREA(ERROR-MSG) to LGSTSQ marshalled past the 71-byte record on GenApp's error paths.
EXEC CICS READ LENGTH was refused after #4411, so LGUCVS01 and LGUPVS01 lost their proofs.
The 14 CardDemo equivalence ports' facades still used the old typed COMMAREA after #4427 and needed regenerating.
COSGN00C's facade took no COMMAREA although its pseudo-conversation RETURNs one to itself (opaque ODO).
Long.parseLong on a text field COBOL MOVEs into a numeric one threw on non-digit data.
The strict branch bar counted statically dead outcomes, so 13 CardDemo programs could not reach it.
The COBOL side of the equivalence harness dropped WRITEQ TS events.
A -- comment with an apostrophe in a case seed.sql was loaded differently by ggsqlrun and the Java side.
The harness had no per-scenario clock and seed data, so time-dependent programs could not be proven.
The harness could not inject a DUPKEY file fault; the cases used DUPREC as a stand-in.
Model ports mishandled a failed XCTL, and the det runtime had no abend path.
The model port left spaces where COSGN00C leaves LOW-VALUES in the RETURN COMMAREA.
The det facade's handleTransaction answered raw EBCDIC bytes when a RETURN's COMMAREA LENGTH was past the DTO.
Equivalence fault runs re-started Maven and Spring each time (~3.8 s each, over 80% of a batch case).
CICS facades were stubs (handleLink threw, void handleTransaction did nothing) instead of the region's behaviour.
CICS proofs did not compare DISPLAY output and treated low-values as spaces (det-port mutation survivors).
The det port gave SQLCODE -4220 where GnuCOBOL/Db2 gives -180 on a null-date update.
BMS map OCCURS fields (ACCOUNTD OCCURS 10) could not be compared by occurrence.
A RETURN TRANSID COMMAREA crossed to the next task as its DTO only, losing a numeric field holding spaces.
equivalence_db2._clp reported success when 'db2 connect' failed, giving misleading 'no table' errors.
ESDS browse by RBA (STARTBR/READNEXT ... RBA) was refused, blocking EPSMLIST.
The forge and differential read a multi-program source as one program, blocking EPSCSMRD onboarding.
The equivalence harness had no BMS map support.

The equivalence harness could not run a CICS task with no COMMAREA (KeyError / IndexError on an empty LINKAGE SECTION) or state a COMMAREA length per scenario; the estate's Java side did not compile without BMS maps.
The equivalence harness had no input channel or output containers (RUN TRANSID CHANNEL / LINK CHANNEL callers, GET / PUT CONTAINER), which every async service takes.
The det runtime's STARTBR NOTFND / IOERR left RESP2 (EIBRESP2) 0 where the stub and z/OS give 3, exposed once the proof compared DISPLAY output (RESP / REAS shown by COBIL00C).
A MOVE between same-shape zoned items is a byte copy in cobc, so spaces reached a PIC 9(3) CVV; the det runtime stored zeros, and the entity-backed card file cannot hold non-digit bytes at all.
Generated indexed inputs were loaded in ASCII key order where IBM uses EBCDIC prime-key order, so the duplicate alternate-key pick (first XREFFILE record per account) differed.

RECORD KEY EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM is defined in WORKING-STORAGE, not the file's record (source IBM and the oracle reject); the translator counted both whole until the OPEN / READ / WRITE / CLOSE was refused by name. Owner decision 2026-10-21: frontier (#5866).
SET ADDRESS OF over z/OS control blocks (PSA, TCB, TIOT) left 5 holes: the program walks the TIOT to read its own DD names.
Batch EXEC DLI (GN, GNP, DLET, CHKP) and the DIB outside CICS were not modelled: 10 holes.
CALL DSNTIAC left 1 hole: Db2's message text is not modelled (oracle assumption Q5), so COTRTLIC could not translate whole.
ALTER and the altered GO TO were an agreed refusal (9 holes); owner decision 2026-10-18 modelled them.
cobol_coverage.LineMap paired a rewritten EXEC CICS INQUIRE block line by line as exact, so the WHEN COPAUS0C arm never showed as taken although the scenarios ran it.
A GO TO into a paragraph that only RETURNs was not a transfer of control, so CORPT00C's SEND-then-GO-TO outcomes needed hand-written infeasible-outcome entries.
LINK left RESP2 0 on failure, and RETURN TRANSID COMMAREA LENGTH past the DTO still passed only the DTO (CardDemo: 2000 over 172 bytes).
A CICS program has several inbound COMMAREAs (menu 160 bytes, own re-entry 2000 bytes) but the interface was taken from resolved callers only, leaving a TODO at every menu dispatch case.
The generated JPA entity for PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS mapped CURRENT-DATE to a reserved SQL column name, so the table was not created on H2.

Forge-generated facades answered a byte[] for a wide RETURN COMMAREA, and an XCTL without COMMAREA to a target whose RETURN is wide kept the byte[] (siblings of #4695; no burned program needed it to climb a rung).
The remaining CardDemo MQ program and the MQINQ / MQSET calls it uses were not modelled; CMQGMOV / CMQODV copybooks refused the program whole.
A COMMAREA DTO property the CICS port could not convert (an OCCURS table as List<String>) refused both programs.

Mutation-survivor gaps across seven CardDemo ports: the harness compared SEND TEXT by text only, so an options-changing mutant read as proven (#5412); the oracle refuses 16 of COCRDLIC's 46 scenarios (register X8, open).
IOERR has no oracle abend code (abendOn defaults to INVREQ) and two COUSR00C harness gaps return after an XCTL; found while faulting its XCTL sites.
The equivalence harness had no java-facade side: the 14 regenerated CardDemo ports were proven through runTask only, and cross-program facade sides carried an untyped Object.
